text:
Conflict card: An input with eligible = true and fraud_hold = true in context card triggers both rules.

Rule A - Refund eligible purchases - applies and requires action refund.
Rule B - Route fraud-held purchases to manual review - applies and requires action manual_review.

The actions refund and manual_review are incompatible for this input. Which rule should win?
cost_basis: all terminal provider usage, persisted from first request
